topics.title: Rise and Fall of the Delhi Sultanate
topics.ncert_sections: Rise and Fall of the Delhi Sultanate

concepts.learning_objective: Name the five dynasties of the Delhi Sultanate in order and describe the instability of its successions.
Explain the campaigns of Ala-ud-din Khilji and the schemes of Muhammad bin Tughlaq.
Describe Timur's attack on Delhi and its effect on the Sultanate.
Describe how the Eastern Ganga kingdom under Narasimhadeva I resisted the Sultanate.
Explain the resistance of the Hoysalas and the Telugu chieftains in the south.
Identify the regional Sultanates and the Mewar kingdom as challenges to Delhi's power.
Describe the founding of Vijayanagara and its rivals in the Deccan.
Explain the military and cultural achievements of Krishnadevaraya's reign.
Analyse the effects of the Battle of Talikota on the Vijayanagara Empire.
Describe how Babur's victory at Panipat founded the Mughal Empire.
Explain the military and political strategies Akbar used to expand and stabilise his empire.
Describe the reigns of Shah Jahan and Aurangzeb and the causes of Mughal decline.

topics.title: Resistance to the Mughals: Peasants, Tribes and Rajputs
topics.ncert_sections: Resistance to the Mughals; Surge of the Rajputs

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the resistance of peasant communities, tribal groups and Rani Durgavati.
Explain how Rajput rulers such as Maharana Pratap resisted Mughal dominance.

topics.title: The Ahoms and the Rise of the Sikhs
topics.ncert_sections: The Ahoms; The Rise of the Sikhs

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the paik system and how the Ahoms defended their independence.
Describe how the Sikh Gurus responded to persecution and the founding of the Khalsa.
Describe the role of the sultan and the iqta system of the Delhi Sultanate.
Identify the duties of Akbar's ministers and the division of the empire into subahs.
Explain the mansabdari system and Todar Mal's revenue reforms.

topics.title: People's Lives
topics.ncert_sections: People's Lives; Temples as centres of economic activity

concepts.learning_objective: Describe agriculture, crafts and trade in the period and the condition of common people.
Explain how the hundi system helped merchants trade across political boundaries.
Describe the economic role of temples in this period.
